rule.name: ServiceLocatorLookup
rule.message: Take the dependency as a constructor parameter (a Provider or Instance parameter when it is optional or created per use) instead of looking it up from a Guice Injector, CDI, a BeanManager or a JNDI context where it is used: the lookup hides what the class needs. The main method, the configure method of a Guice Module, @Provides and @Produces methods, @Bean methods of a @Configuration class and CDI extensions may look dependencies up.

property.name: xpath
property.value: ( //MethodCall [pmd-java:matchesSig('com.google.inject.Injector#getInstance(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('com.google.inject.Injector#getProvider(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('com.google.inject.Injector#getBinding(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('com.google.inject.Injector#getExistingBinding(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('jakarta.enterprise.inject.spi.BeanContainer#getReference(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('jakarta.enterprise.inject.spi.BeanContainer#createInstance()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('jakarta.enterprise.inject.spi.BeanManager#getInjectableReference(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('javax.enterprise.inject.spi.BeanManager#getReference(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('javax.enterprise.inject.spi.BeanManager#getInjectableReference(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('javax.enterprise.inject.spi.BeanManager#createInstance()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('jakarta.enterprise.inject.spi.CDI#current()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('javax.enterprise.inject.spi.CDI#current()') or (@MethodName = 'select' and *[1][not(self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'current'])] [pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.enterprise.inject.spi.CDI') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.enterprise.inject.spi.CDI')]) or ((pmd-java:matchesSig('javax.naming.Context#lookup(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('javax.naming.Context#lookupLink(_*)')) and not(*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('javax.naming.directory.DirContext')])) or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.springframework.jndi.JndiTemplate#lookup(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.springframework.jndi.JndiLocatorDelegate#lookup(_*)')] | //MethodReference [(@MethodName = ('getInstance', 'getProvider', 'getBinding', 'getExistingBinding') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('com.google.inject.Injector')]) or (@MethodName = ('getReference', 'getInjectableReference', 'createInstance') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.enterprise.inject.spi.BeanContainer') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.enterprise.inject.spi.BeanContainer') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.enterprise.inject.spi.BeanManager')]) or (@MethodName = 'current' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.enterprise.inject.spi.CDI') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.enterprise.inject.spi.CDI')]) or (@MethodName = ('lookup', 'lookupLink') and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('javax.naming.Context')] [not(pmd-java:typeIs('javax.naming.directory.DirContext'))]) or (@MethodName = 'lookup' and *[1][pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jndi.JndiTemplate') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.jndi.JndiLocatorDelegate')])] ) [not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration [pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.enterprise.inject.spi.Extension') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.enterprise.inject.spi.Extension')])] [not(ancestor::MethodDeclaration[1] [(@Name = 'main' and @Void = true() and (FormalParameters/@Size = 0 or FormalParameters[@Size = 1]/FormalParameter [ArrayType[ClassType[pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.String')]][count(ArrayDimensions/*) = 1] or ClassType[pmd-java:typeIsExactly('java.lang.String')][count(../VariableId/ArrayDimensions/*) = 1]])) or (@Name = 'configure' and FormalParameters/@Size = 0 and (../.. | ../../self::AnonymousClassDeclaration/..) [pmd-java:typeIs('com.google.inject.Module')]) or ModifierList/Annotation [pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.enterprise.inject.Produces') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.enterprise.inject.Produces') or pmd-java:typeIs('com.google.inject.Provides')] or (ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean')] and ../../ModifierList/Annotation [pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.SpringBootConfiguration') or pmd-java:typeIs('org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication')])])]
